# Nandzz

> Nandzz gives businesses, solo pros, and institutions a branded one-page site plus
> built-in features — booking, content, and pools — so they can be found on social
> and booked in a tap. No website needed: claim a handle (nandzz.com/yourbrand), add
> the features you need, and share the link.

## What Nandzz is

- A branded public page at `nandzz.com/[handle]` that works as a link-in-bio destination and a lightweight business site.
- A suite of features you add to that page: **Booking** (24/7 appointments with staff and availability), **Content** (publish pages, PDFs, and interactive tools), and **Pools** (bundle links, offers, and resources into one shared collection). More features are planned.
- An optional **AI Agent** visitors can chat with, and **MCP access** so tools like Claude can connect to a page.
- Aimed at salons, barbers, cleaners, studios, clinics, coaches, freelancers, and small institutions.

## How it compares

- Versus link-in-bio tools (Linktree, Beacons): Nandzz adds real booking and content, not just a list of links.
- Versus scheduling tools (Calendly, Acuity): Nandzz is a branded page, not a bare calendar link.
- Versus vertical booking suites (Fresha, Booksy): Nandzz is not locked to one industry; you turn on only the features you need.
- Versus website builders (Squarespace, Wix): Nandzz is the fast presence-plus-action layer, not a heavy DIY site.

## Pricing

- Free: a branded page with content, gallery, and links sections (up to 25 spaces).
- One paid plan — €27/month or €270/year (2 months free): unlocks Booking, the AI Agent, MCP access, analytics, and unlimited spaces.
- Machine-readable pricing: https://nandzz.com/pricing.md
- Human pricing page: https://nandzz.com/pricing
